provenance.what: PTSG-WPMS-Formation instruction encoding (Implementation Arena, master Ch.3 CL-5): bit positions of sub-op, register ID and immediate inside D8-D31 of a Core Global word with mode >= 1
source_of_truth_for: hw/l2/wpms_decode.vh (RTL decoder table, generated by hw/tools/gen_decode.py)
hw/l2/decode_map.md (published map, written from this file)
provenance.checked_against: 03_Sample_Implementations/tools/isa_table_w.json (every contract row present with its {mode, sub-op}; every removed row decodes to E4)
provenance.ids: source and destination ID assignments are ISA-normative (master Ch.2 section 2.9); only their bit positions are Arena

mode.note: D4-D7: Formation mode 1..15 (0 = Core-internal Global); on the bus as ext_op_subopcode[3:0]

subop.note: D8-D11: sub-op within the mode; on the bus as ext_op_sub_operand[3:0]

rid.note: D12-D15: source ID (LDA ADD SUB MUL MAC STP) or destination ID (STA); on the bus as ext_op_sub_operand[7:4]

imm.note: D16-D31: immediate / literal; on the bus as ext_op_data[15:0] (the Core holds the timing signals while a window runs, so D16-D31 is always an operand here)

src.imm: signed 16-bit value when rid = IMM (sign-extended to 32 bits); must be 0 otherwise

lit9.imm: unsigned 9-bit ADRS literal in D16-D24; D25-D31 must be 0

shift.imm: signed 16-bit shift count: >= 0 arithmetic right, < 0 left (E8 on overflow)

must_be_zero_rule: A field an instruction does not use must be 0; a non-zero value is E4 (master Ch.2 section 2.9: silence is never a semantics). The assembler never emits one.

LDM.note: ADRS post-increments always (Map v0.3 section 3); no increment flag in this profile

assembler_operands.@PPM: PPM source (reads the L2 space at ADRS) / STORE destination (writes the L2 space at ADRS)

E4.cause: reserved or removed {mode, sub-op}, reserved source/destination ID, or a non-zero must-be-zero field

E5.cause: ADRS outside the map of Map v0.3 section 4 (0x11B-0x1FF) at LDM, STM or an @PPM operand

E8.cause: MUL, MAC or SFT (left) result outside signed 32 bits (SFT as the golden model: SD-13)

EW2.cause: prefetch of a block with N outside [N_MIN, NMAX]

EW3.cause: write into a read-only region (inbox view, COMMIT view, sweep words, status)

EW4.cause: write-window violation: store written outside HK, CUR written outside a packet window, BCP outside HK

EW5.cause: invalid sweep word at BCP (P > 8, repeated block, sum N > NMAX) or sum N of the sweep in effect > NMAX

TS_PKT.note: timing_signals[0] (D16 of Stay Set and Stay words): packet Stay

TS_CSEL.note: timing_signals[2:1]: Condition lane select, 0 STROBE, 1 NONEMPTY, 2 MORE, 3 reserved (W-R16)
